game_start.intro: The game begins. Trump suit: {trump_suit} (trump card: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in German Whist.
{phase_info}
You hold {hand_size} cards.
Play a card with '[play N]', where N is its position in your hand (for example '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: KOTA TËNDE: Zo so asö benda na yâ ti kpengo li oko oko ayeke mû carte ni, me zo so atï na ngangu ayeke gboto mbeni mbeti nde. Atënë kue so a wara na ngoi ti kpengbingo lê tongaso ayeke ga pëpe ye ti mungo maboko ndali ti songo benda.
player_prompt.phase_playing: Na peko ti so a hunzi kua ni awe, ye kue ayeke ga na e songo benda.

next_card.playing_phase: A yeke mû mbeni carte oko pëpe, a to nda ti sala ngia ni awe.
next_card.deck_empty: A zia mbeni carte na ndo ni pëpe.
next_card.available: A mû carte ni na ala: {card}
next_card.available_trump: A mû carte ni na ala: {card} (TRUMP)

invalid_move.wrong_format: A yeke na lege ni pëpe ti zia carte so ayeke na maboko. Sara kua na "[play N]" ti pika n-ngbonga oko kue so mo wara na yâ ti maboko ti mo.
invalid_move.bad_position: A yeke wara pëpe carte so na yâ ti mbeti ni. Mo gbu {hand_size} carte.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: A lingbi mo mû tapande ti lo na mo zia mbeni carte {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: A lingbi ti sala kusala na carte so pëpe.

game_action.played: Zo ti pikango ye {player_id} ayeke pika lani na {card}.

trick.won: Zo ti pikango ye {winner_id} awara triche ni na lege so lo sala kusala na {card}.
trick.won_learning: Mîngî {winner_id} lôzî trick na {card} mpô na kôzo kâti kôzo.

phase.learning_complete: A hunzi ti manda ye awe, na a yeke sala kusala na angangu kode kue so angbâ.

draw.winner_received: Mo wara ye ti ngangu ni na mo wara {card}.
draw.loser_received: Mo girisa ti sara ye so a hunda na mo, nga mo gboto {card}.
draw.winner_preview: Na pekoni, a yeke mû carte {card}.

turn.scores_learning: Tricks won so far - Player 0: {tricks0}, Player 1: {tricks1}

hand.no_cards: A yeke wara carte na yâ ni ape.
hand.no_cards_in_hand: A yeke wara carte na maboko ti ala pëpe.

trick_view.empty: Mbeni zo ti kpengo na carte ni so ayeke dä pëpe.

board_str.not_started: A komanse ti sara ngia ni ape
board_str.header: === GAME TI NGBANGU NA ZO NI NDOKO===
board_str.player_line:
{observation}
Player {player_id}: {scoring} scoring tricks ({tricks} total), {hand_size} cards in hand

outcome.summary: Learning phase - Player 0: {l0}, Player 1: {l1}. Playing phase - Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}. Player {winner_id} wins with {winner_tricks} scoring tricks!
